description.en:
Removes a caption created with CMND_2DO_CREATE_TELOP, CMND_2DO_CREATE_AVA_TELOP or CMND_2DO_CREATE_AVA_SUB_TELOP, by the name it was registered under.
The cutscene scripts call it at the end of the sequence to clean up their captions.
Name of the caption to remove.

The name you passed (not null) if a caption with that name existed and was removed.
null if no caption had that name, if no argument was given, or if the engine is not ready.
(On success the native reports a result without pushing one, so Squirrel hands back the last argument, which here is the name.)

examples.case: Cleaning up both captions after a Fighting Spirit move (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut; caption names shortened from the script's Shift-JIS names)
